zh:
香港科技大学（The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology，简称HKUST）成立于1991年，位于中国香港九龙清水湾，是香港顶尖的公立研究型大学。学校下设4个学院，覆盖工程、商学、自然科学、人文社科等领域，在广州设有分校区，在校生超17000人，其中研究生约8000名。
香港科技大学在2026QS世界大学排名中位列全球第44位，以科技创新与商科教育闻名全球，在工程、人工智能、材料科学、金融科技等领域处于亚洲领先地位。学校99%的教授入选全球前2%顶尖科学家，培育了超900家活跃初创企业与大量独角兽企业，在科研成果转化与创新创业教育方面成果显著，2025年正式启动医学院筹备工作，进一步拓展学科布局。
en: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST) is a top public research university in Hong Kong. Founded in 1991, it is located in Clear Water Bay, Kowloon, Hong Kong, with a second campus in Guangzhou. The University comprises 4 faculties, covering engineering, business, natural sciences, and humanities and social sciences, with over 17,000 enrolled students, including 8,000 graduate students. Ranked 44th globally in the 2026 QS World University Rankings, HKUST is world-renowned for technological innovation and business education, leading Asia in engineering, AI, materials science, and fintech. 99% of its faculty are ranked in the world's top 2% of scientists. Ranked No.44 in the world in the 2026 QS World University Rankings.
